$Comment: Gunter's melee attack (2026-10-21: almost always the wing slaps, the headbutt and the belly lunge now and then). ChainingAllowance 15: after 15 s without attacking he starts again from the first step. Damage per attack: AT_Gunter_Slap/Belly/Headbutt_Damage.
